exercises.answer: The tourist visits for leisure, while the adult student attends a course.

video.title: Checking the current route
video.idea: Read this adult travel account and pause on a stated distinction. Keep vehicles stationary and personal data unreadable; text rather than appearance establishes roles and journey details.
video.scriptStarter: One visitor is a tourist, travelling for leisure. Maya is an adult student on an evening course. Another person describes herself as elderly; older person is often a natural respectful alternative. Age alone does not establish mobility, ability or fare eligibility.
